# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary assessment artifacts generated for the current versioned report.

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md) - High-level and component-level application structure.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md) - Declared framework and package dependencies grouped by category.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md) - HTTP surface, request flow, and communication patterns.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) - Database usage, inferred entity model, and persistence behaviors.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration sources, secrets handling, and runtime settings.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) - Business-facing workflows, rules, and sequence diagrams.
